newsitem.title: USA: Sight Resource puzzled by stock drop.
newsitem.headline: Sight Resource puzzled by stock drop.

text.p: Sight Resource Corp said Thursday it was puzzled by the recent decline in its stock, especially in light of what it called positive developments it has previously announced.
President and Chief Executive Officer William McLendon issued the statement in response to investor inquiries.

The company said it expects to report first quarter revenues of more than $10 million, which is said was up 51 percent from a year ago. It said it expects to announce first quarter results in the next few weeks.
Sight Resource was up 3/8 to four at midmorning on Nasdaq.
